item.title: Penn State Wrestling Wins Big Ten Championship, School-Record 7 Nittany Lions Claim Individual Titles
item.description: Penn State wrestling ran away with its fourth consecutive Big Ten team title and set a program record for individual champions in a year with seven on Sunday to wrap up the two-day conference tournament at the Bryce Jordan Center. Luke LIlledahl (125), Shayne Van Ness (149), PJ Duke (157), Mitchell Mesenbrink (165), Levi Haines (174), Rocco Welsh (184) and Josh Barr (197) each won titles for the Nittany Lions, who also set a school record for points at the championships with 184. item.title: Penn State’s PJ Duke Named Outstanding Wrestler of the Big Ten Championships
item.description: PJ Duke won Outstanding Wrestler of the Big Ten Championships on Sunday to cap off an impressive weekend at the Bryce Jordan Center for the Penn State true freshman and his teammates. The No. 2 seed at 157 pounds, Duke defeated No. 1 seed Antrell Taylor of Nebraska to claim the title in his first conference tournament. item.title: Report: Former Penn State WR Jahan Dotson Signs With Atlanta Falcons
item.description: A former Penn State star is headed to his third NFL team. Wide receiver Jahan Dotson has signed with the Atlanta Falcons on a two-year, $15 million deal, according to ESPN's Adam Schefter. He's set to make $10 million in guaranteed money. Dotson was drafted No. 16 overall in 2022 by the Washington Commanders, where he spent his first two seasons. item.title: Reports: Former Penn State DE Odafe Oweh Signs With Washington Commanders
item.description: A former Penn State defensive end just got paid. On Monday, Odafe Oweh signed a four-year, $100 million deal with the Washington Commanders, according to multiple reports, his third team since entering the league. Oweh began his professional career with the Baltimore Ravens, who drafted him No. 31 overall in 2021, appearing in 67 games across four and a half seasons. item.title: PennDOT Releases Draft Environmental Impact Statement for State College Area Connector
item.description: PennDOT has opened public comment for a draft report on the environmental and property impacts of a proposed major Route 322 project in Centre County now estimated to cost upwards of $1 billion.
